### Feature Category
- [ ] New Airframe Performance Model (e.g. Sikorsky S-76, Leonardo AW139, EC135)
- [ ] Telemetry & Weather Feed Decoders (e.g. Pireps, G-AIRMETs, European METARs)
- [ ] Flight Regulations / Operations (e.g. EASA SPA.HEMS, IFR Transition Matrix)
- [ ] Dispatcher HUD & UI Features
- [ ] Performance & Optimization
- [ ] Tooling & Infrastructure

### Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or operational challenge? Please describe. (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when evaluating European HEMS operations because...")

### Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you would like to see implemented. Include mathematical models, regulatory citations, or OEM RFM chart references if applicable.

### Alternative Solutions Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

### Flight Safety & Operational Considerations
Does this feature affect deterministic dispatch verdicts or flight safety criteria? How should it be verified offline?

### Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, or references here.
